authenticity_review: The image exhibits catastrophic structural failures in the primary subject. The second object is disproportionately small and fragmented. While the suitcase and materials (velvet, brass texture) are rendered with high photorealism and lighting, the core subject matter is nonsensical, severely impacting authenticity.
